purpose: First acquisition batch: individual official Egyptian legal documents. Permission rationale is limited to official-document copyright status under Article 141 of Law 82/2002; this is not permission to crawl source websites or bypass access controls.
instructions: This manifest contains a small set of individually identified official-document candidates; it is not a complete or consolidated corpus.

The Article 141 copyright rationale for an official document does not itself establish permission to automate access to a source website, bypass technical controls, use subscription-restricted archives, or reuse third-party database material.
All entries remain permission_pending until the exact URL, source terms/access restrictions, intended storage, extraction, indexing, commercial use and display have been reviewed and documented.
Do not change collection_permission to allowed unless evidence covers the actual intended collection method and uses, the terms_checked_on date is populated, and the approved hostname is confirmed.
Downloaded records must remain pending authenticity, commencement, amendment-history, extraction and current-status review.
This is an example manifest and must not be treated as a ready-to-run authorized acquisition batch.
